content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for ECHS Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.echs.gov.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 31-08-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for ECHS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to receive the application for ECHS Para Medical and Non Medical Staff posts is 31 August 2026. Candidates must ensure their applications reach the designated address by this date.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in ECHS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies for Para Medical and Non Medical Staff posts in ECHS Recruitment 2026. These vacancies are distributed across various positions as per the official notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for ECHS Para Medical and Non Medical Staff posts?
faq.answer: The application mode for ECHS Para Medical and Non Medical Staff posts is offline. Candidates need to download the form, fill it, and send the completed application along with required documents by post.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for ECHS Para Medical and Non Medical Staff posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for ECHS Para Medical and Non Medical Staff posts is 56 years. Candidates must ensure they meet this age criterion before applying for the positions.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for ECHS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process for ECHS Para Medical and Non Medical Staff posts primarily involves an interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their applications and called for an interview.

faq.question: Q6. What are the qualifications required for Nursing Assistant post in ECHS?
faq.answer: For the Nursing Assistant post, candidates must possess a GNM or a Diploma Class 1 Nursing Assistant Course (Armed Forces). These qualifications are essential for eligibility.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for ECHS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for ECHS Para Medical and Non Medical Staff posts. This makes it accessible for all eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q8. When is the interview date for ECHS Para Medical and Non Medical Staff posts?
faq.answer: The interview date for ECHS Para Medical and Non Medical Staff posts is scheduled for 10 September 2026. Candidates are advised to keep this date in mind for their preparation.

faq.question: Q9. What is the official website for ECHS Recruitment?
faq.answer: The official website for Ex Servicemen Contributory Health Scheme (ECHS) is www.echs.gov.in. Candidates can visit this website to download the application form and access official notifications.

faq.question: Q10. What type of job is offered in ECHS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The jobs offered under ECHS Recruitment 2026 for Para Medical and Non Medical Staff are contractual in nature. These positions provide an opportunity to serve in a government-affiliated scheme.
